source_expansion.criterion: Each weakTX outRX feature-margin q10 >= same-seed BASE+.002; eligible gap calls>=85%; active hinge calls>=10%; all15RXday cells seen>=20times; RXspread/interclassgap <=1.05x BASE; no zero features; defaulthead overall>=-.2pp,worstRX>=-.5pp,anyTX>=-1pp. Fixed source only before target.

result.limitation: Exposed exploratory Phase1 clean benchmark. Source promotion fixed before new candidate target. Default head joint throughout. No target tuning, independent blind-test, Phase2, or satellite claim.

gap_logs.interpretation: Source geometric penalty only. Signed cross product is not certified unbiased for dependent finite-pool halves; no fitted classifier or target guarantee.
